failures: Two preflight runs encountered the macOS /var alias; the real owner CLI refused the symlink ancestor. A fresh synthetic fixture under its resolved /private/var path was used.
The macOS Python os module lacks listxattr. Descriptor-based native flistxattr/fgetxattr was used.
Native inspection found com.apple.provenance on generated entries, so the harness captured and compared actual values instead of assuming empty xattrs.
harness_preflight.scope: Only disposable synthetic rehearsal locations were involved; failed fixtures were retained. No production behavior was loosened.

limitations_and_remaining: This is a synthetic Mac rehearsal of the preservation workflow, not a new production archive, cryptographic signature acceptance or successful recovery of an original case.

Archive and restored copy share this Mac failure domain; independent media replication, durability after restart, original attribute acquisition and the future minimum 30 day retention condition remain unverified.
No original store cleanup is authorized or performed. Real pending/provider state and deadlines were not read, changed, shortened or cleared.

Original 6 successful and 2 unfinished cases remain unchanged. The normal cached-case recovery and the separate new case with fresh signed baseline/update CVD inputs and its own natural 48 hour wait remain separate work.
